282042319.description:
Waterman's
Black Dip Pen with Original Presentation Case
Early to Mid-20th Century
This vintage Waterman's writing instrument features a slender, elongated black tapered staff paired with a decorative gold-tone ferrule and metal nib assembly with an attached reservoir clip. Housed in an authentic hinged Waterman's clamshell presentation case with cream-colored ribbed fabric lining and branded silk-screened satin lid, this piece exemplifies classic early to mid-20th century desk pen design and stationery presentation.
Black finished tapered staff holder with knurled gold-tone metal ferrule collar
Fitted metal writing nib featuring an integrated ink reservoir attachment
Authentic hinged Waterman's presentation box with tan textured exterior and lined interior
"Waterman's" maker name clearly printed across the interior lid satin liner
Pen length measures approximately 8 inches overall
Condition:
Vintage condition consistent with age and prior use. Staff shows light surface wear and minor scuffing along the black finish. The metal nib displays significant ink residue, surface oxidation, and finish wear across the reservoir clip. Presentation case hinges properly and latches securely; interior satin exhibits light foxing and ink staining along the edge corners, with exterior showing minor shelf wear.
THANK YOU FOR YOUR PURCHASE!
If you’re happy and you know it, please leave a 5-star rating! If there is a problem with your order, please contact us via Shop Goodwill before opening returns/claims. We strive to return all messages within one business day.

Our shipping team works hard to get out all orders as quickly as possible, that being said it may take up to 5 business days after payment for your order to ship out.  Once it ships out you will receive tracking information.
***IMPORTANT*** If your item was damaged in transit, do not throw away anything, including the box or packing materials until we have authorized you to do so. Photos will be required to file insurance claims.
Our Business hours: Monday - Friday  8:00 am to 4:00 pm Central

Description:
This bundle presents a diverse collection of crystal and mineral rocks, ideal for collectors, learners, or as decorative accents. The set includes various natural specimens, such as polished geode halves displaying distinct striated patterns, crystalline clusters with glimmering surfaces, and notable mineral samples. Two labeled display cards are included, featuring mounted specimens: one card lists anthracite coal, banded sandstone, copper ore, granite, and marble; the other card displays amethyst, carnelian, jade (missing piece), milky quartz, and tiger eye. Each stone is unique in coloration, texture, and shape, providing both visual appeal and educational value. The assortment will enhance any decor, spark curiosity in geology, or serve as a tactile teaching aid. The items are in used condition with minor handling wear and the jade piece is missing from the display card. Overall, this bundle showcases visually striking and varied stones, suitable for display, collecting, or gifting to crystal enthusiasts. Category: Collectibles & Art
